heading: Words gathered along the way.
intro: An archive of essays, reflections, and poetry. Some published elsewhere, some kept here.

sections.heading: Gimbles and Toads
sections.body:
On Substack, I've shared essays about philosophy, creativity, memory, and the strange business of being human. Some are personal; others begin with an idea and follow it wherever it leads.

[Read and subscribe on Substack ↗](https://isiahfletcher7.substack.com/)

sections.heading: Poetry and other writing
sections.body:
Some of my poems are collected on the site's earlier Hobbies page. They're part of this archive too.

[Read selected poems ↗](/hobbies)
